title: probing-ensemble-anchoring-and-soft-revert-ci-hook
author: Marta Klein
release_notes: Adds a probe-ensemble anchoring CI hook that reduces false-positive regression signals by probabilistically anchoring ensemble votes across seeds and enabling configurable soft-reverts of prompt snapshots when confidence drops below adaptive thresholds.
description:
Motivation: We frequently see noisy regression failures that are actually seed/ensemble variance or transient distribution shifts in prompt cohorts. This PR implements a lightweight 'probe-ensemble anchoring' CI hook and a soft-revert mechanism that reduces noisy alerting and gives teams a controlled rollback path when a prompt-set regression is likely real.

What this PR does: Implements a new CI hook (eval/ci/hooks/probe_ensemble_anchor.py) that runs short probabilistic ensembles across multiple RNG seeds and aggregates a calibrated anchor score per prompt-cohort. Anchoring blends historical snapshot agreement with current ensemble consensus using an exponential decay so recent stable behavior has higher weight. A separate 'soft-revert' policy (eval/ci/soft_revert.py) uses the anchor score plus a smoothed regression metric to decide whether to: 1) file an actionable regression, 2) mute/soft-fail (mark as flaky) and schedule follow-up probes, or 3) trigger an automated snapshot rollback for the prompt-set with a human review tag.

Key features: - Probabilistic ensemble runner with configurable sample budget and per-cohort stratified sampling. - Anchor score that fuses historical agreement, current consensus, and seed entropy to reduce false-positives. - Adaptive thresholds: thresholds are percentile-based and adjust with empirical variance, avoiding brittle fixed cutoffs. - Soft-revert flow: when confidence is high that a regression is due to a bad rollout, the CI creates a rollback candidate, attaches diagnostics (diffs, failing examples, anchor trace), and leaves the final revert to a human-approved workflow. - Metrics: new telemetry (eval.anchor_score, eval.anchor_entropy, eval.soft_revert_candidates) and debug traces emitted to the eval telemetry pipeline.

Implementation notes: - New files added under eval/ci/hooks/, eval/metrics/, and tests/mini_probes/. - No changes to production serving code; all logic lives in eval-harness and CI. - Introduces a small deterministic state file format (jsonl) for anchor snapshots; migration script included to backfill anchor history from recent smoke-eval runs. - Performance: probe runs are short (default 5 seeds, 3 samples per prompt) and gated behind a configurable 'probe budget' to avoid CI cost blowup.

Testing: - Unit tests for anchor math and thresholding (tests/test_anchor.py). - Integration smoke test that runs a staged probe against a small prompt set and asserts soft-revert candidate generation only for targeted failures (tests/test_soft_revert_flow.py). - Added CI job eval-probe-quick that runs the new hook on PRs labeled with 'eval-probe'.

Files changed (high level): - eval/ci/hooks/probe_ensemble_anchor.py - eval/ci/soft_revert.py - eval/metrics/anchor_metrics.py - eval/cli/commands.py (hook registration) - tests/test_anchor.py - tests/test_soft_revert_flow.py - scripts/backfill_anchor_history.py - docs/eval/anchor-probe.md - examples/anchor-demo/{small_prompt_set.json,run_probe.sh}

Related work: This complements ENG-3922 (prompt snapshotting) and ENG-4100 (cohort stratified sampling). It is intentionally conservative: default configuration mutes automated reverts unless a confidence threshold and human-approved policy are both satisfied.

Risks and mitigation: - Risk: new logic could hide real regressions. Mitigation: soft-revert defaults to opt-in autosnap/revert and always surfaces human-reviewable artifacts; thresholds are conservative and telemetry visible in the eval dashboard. - Risk: CI cost increase. Mitigation: probe budget and quick-probe job keep incremental cost small.

Request: Please review the anchor math, threshold defaults, and the soft-revert human-approval flow. I added detailed commentary in the hook file and tests for clarity.

merge_commit_message:
Add probe-ensemble anchoring CI hook with soft-revert flow and tests

This implements probabilistic anchoring, adaptive thresholds, and a human-in-the-loop soft-revert path for noisy prompt-set regressions.
notes: Conservative defaults enabled; recommend monitoring eval.anchor_score and eval.soft_revert_candidates for 2 weeks after rollout.
